Definition: Nibchaz, a deity of the Avites
BiblicalUsage: Nibhaz is one of the gods the Avites make for themselves when they are settled in Samaria, named beside Tartak and the gods of Sepharvaim to whom children are burned. He is a god carried in by strangers and set up in God's land.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a god men make for themselves is no god at all — Nibhaz arrived with the Avites and never had any claim on Israel.
